skill.summary: Use when a user asks to optimize, sharpen, clarify, rewrite, pressure-test, or improve an input, prompt, question, requirement, plan, idea, or message before...

latestVersion.changelog:
SharpInput 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces an AI-powered input compiler to upgrade prompts, questions, and ideas for better AI responses.
- Ensures upgraded prompts preserve user intent, do not answer the underlying task, and are ready to copy.
- Implements a gate system (Level 0–3) for handling input complexity, from simple rewording to high-risk, multi-path cases.
- Modular architecture with focused skills for intent detection, scenario analysis, context completion, prompt compilation, and review.
- Includes quality controls: output must identify level/intent, give a brief diagnosis, provide one ready-to-use upgraded prompt, specify improvements, and note any remaining gaps.
